closure.closed_title.description: The title of the screen that replaces every other after the server closed (its name in place of {name}); the reader can only take their data away.

closure.closed_export.defaultMessage: {date} まで、データをダウンロードできます。
closure.closed_export.description: Under the title of the closed server's screen: the last day the reader can still sign in and take their data ({date}, a date written out in the reader's language).

closure.request_export.defaultMessage: データのエクスポートを依頼
closure.request_export.description: The button on the closed server's screen that starts building an archive of everything the reader has (posts, profile, follows), to download when it is ready.

closure.export_requested.defaultMessage: エクスポートを準備しています。できあがると、ここからダウンロードできます。
closure.export_requested.description: What the closed server's screen says while the archive of the reader's data is being built (after a request, and on every visit until it is ready); the request button waits meanwhile.

closure.export_failed.defaultMessage: エクスポートを依頼できませんでした。時間をおいてもう一度試してください。
closure.export_failed.description: What the closed server's screen says when the server refused the request of an archive of the reader's data (one already being built, too many today).

closure.download_follows.defaultMessage: フォロー中のアカウントを CSV でダウンロード
closure.download_follows.description: The button on the closed server's screen that saves the list of accounts the reader follows as a CSV file, which another server can import.

closure.download_failed.defaultMessage: CSV をダウンロードできませんでした。もう一度試してください。
closure.download_failed.description: What the closed server's screen says when the download of the reader's follows as CSV failed.

closure.sign_out.description: The link at the end of the closed server's screen that signs the reader out.

closure.export_ready.defaultMessage: エクスポートの準備ができました。{date} までダウンロードできます。
closure.export_ready.description: On the closed server's screen once the archive of the reader's data is built: until when it can be downloaded ({date}, a date written out in the reader's language).

closure.download_export.defaultMessage: エクスポートをダウンロード
closure.download_export.description: The button on the closed server's screen that saves the archive of the reader's data once it is ready.

closure.export_build_failed.defaultMessage: 前回のエクスポートを準備できませんでした。もう一度依頼してください。
closure.export_build_failed.description: On the closed server's screen when the server failed to build the archive the reader requested last.

closure.export_download_failed.defaultMessage: エクスポートをダウンロードできませんでした。もう一度試してください。
closure.export_download_failed.description: What the closed server's screen says when the download of the ready archive of the reader's data failed.
